push_direction_generator: numpy.Generator(PCG64(seed)), two independent uniform angles in [0, 2*pi), zero vertical force and torque
order: reference then condition; alternate onnx-first and direct_pd-first by pair index
success: All requested steps completed without a detected fall; not a tracking-accuracy success criterion.
fall: Root below 0.45 m or pelvis tilt above 60 degrees for five consecutive control samples. Continue after falls.
early_termination: Stop on non-finite output/state, numerical warning or per-episode wall budget; retain every attempted episode and explicit reason. Contract/setup errors abort with partial output retained.
aggregation: Fall and failure rates use all six episodes per controller. Pool squared joint errors weighted by observed control samples, including fallen/partial episodes. No full-horizon error is reported unless all six episodes completed. No best-seed selection.
interpretation: Fixed self-authored smoke comparison, not a published benchmark, statistical significance claim, training result or SOTA.
